SecurityBaseline._comment: Interactive: BitLocker USB enforcement (Y/N, default: N); Defender sample submission (Y/N, default: N = safe samples only, the documented privacy deviation from Microsoft's SubmitSamplesConsent=3; Y restores 3 = send all samples); SmartScreen level (Y/N, default: N = Block, Microsoft's baseline value; Y = Warn, the documented security-reducing compatibility choice); UAC Strict=0 automatically denies standard-user elevation; SecureDesktop=1 permits standard users to enter separate administrator credentials on the secure desktop. This system-wide standard-user choice does not change an administrator account's own elevation prompts.

ASR._comment: Interactive: Management tools (Y/N), Prevalence rule (Y/N), Cloud protection (C/A)

Privacy._comment: Interactive: Mode (1-3), Cloud Clipboard (Y/N, MSRecommended only), Tier 1 policy-based in-box app removal (Y/N, default N; unmanaged single-session Enterprise/Education 24H2+ only; device-wide app-data loss warning; exact policy-value restore but no exact downstream app/data recovery), Tier 2 classic per-user app removal (Y/N, default N; app data can be lost; separate original-user-only best-effort Store reinstall, NOT exact), then optional Weather/Widgets board removal (Y/N, default N; valid only with Tier 2).

AntiAI.description: Reversible hardening of 43 declared Windows/Edge AI registry targets plus four Copilot URI source checks; current Copilot MSIX requires effective AppLocker/App Control coverage

EdgeHardening.description: Microsoft Edge v139: 19 baseline values plus 7 explicit privacy additions (25 default-selected; 26 with extension block-all)

AdvancedSecurity.description: Advanced Security hardening beyond MS Baseline
AdvancedSecurity._comment: Interactive: Profile (1-3), Windows Firewall layer (Y/N; controller detection is prefill only), RDP (Y/N on host-capable editions), Admin shares (Y/N, domain only), UPnP (Y/N), Wireless Display (Y/N on supported editions), Discovery Protocols (Maximum only, Y/N), IPv6 0xFF component disable (Maximum only, Y/N). Home reports RDP-host, WirelessDisplay and managed Update-policy targets as NotApplicable.

options._comment: nonInteractive=true replaces every decision prompt with the exact validated module values above. DryRun and verbose logging are explicit CLI switches; automatic reboot/confirmation is not supported.
